sprites.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Generate a production-ready transparent PNG sprite atlas for the eight bioluminescent smartwatch scenes. Exact square canvas divided into an EXACTLY aligned 4-column by 4-row grid, 16 equal square cells. Put exactly one isolated complete sprite in the center of each cell, row-major map below. Broad transparent gutters: keep every glow, silhouette, and particle entirely within its cell, with an empty outer 18% safety margin. Grid lines invisible; no backgrounds, cell fills, labels, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, shadows spilling outside cells. Genuine alpha transparency outside artwork. Cohesive luminous fantasy illustration style with clean graphic silhouettes and controlled glow; each sprite must be distinctive, saturated, and readable at 225px watch scale. Palette changes by scene: emerald/cyan/amber, violet/fuchsia, sapphire/turquoise/amber, rose/orchid, coral/amber/indigo, ultramarine/magenta/gold, aqua/lime/teal, emerald/cyan/violet. NOT paper, origami, woodblock, flat printing, photorealism, or 3D. Exact 16-cell map left-to-right, top-to-bottom: row1: (1) complete side-view bicycle with small rider, wheels glowing emerald and amber, facing right; (2) graceful glowing mushroom cluster with violet caps and cyan gills; (3) open compact laptop with sapphire shell, luminous turquoise screen and tiny abstract non-letter strokes; (4) fluffy small kitten with orchid coat and bright rose eyes, one paw reaching right. Row2: (5) small ornate hot-air balloon with coral-and-amber glowing envelope; (6) sleek retro space rocket angled 45 degrees pointing upper-right, ultramarine with magenta fins and gold flame; (7) delicate floating translucent aqua jellyfish with lime highlights and flowing tentacles; (8) small friendly luminous arctic fox standing in profile facing right, emerald and cyan fur with violet highlights. Row3: (9) a few amber and green firefly motes; (10) a few violet glowing spores; (11) one turquoise blinking cursor-like square with tiny glints, absolutely no letters; (12) tiny rose-gold moth with translucent wings. Row4: (13) a small amber dust-and-seed sparkle trail; (14) a cluster of gold and magenta star sparks; (15) three distinct round sea-glass bubbles; (16) a short flowing emerald-and-cyan aurora ribbon with two tiny glints. Keep each sprite centered within its own cell and fully separated. No extra objects.
